concept: HA: Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs behind an ALB
tests: How to design a stateless web tier that survives the failure of an entire AZ.
expected: Auto Scaling group across at least 2 AZs + ALB in the same AZs. Triggers: "entire Availability Zone fails", "stateless web tier", "MOST highly available".
why_not: A single instance (even large or with an Elastic IP) or two in one AZ go down with the AZ.
